name: Excuses
overview: The Scriptures reveal that excuses often arise from a desire to avoid responsibility or fear of unbelief, as seen when Adam blames Eve and Eve blames the serpent for their disobedience. Moses exemplifies this struggle by expressing doubt about his own abilities and the people's acceptance of his message, citing his lack of eloquence and fear that others will not believe him. Yet, God responds by affirming His sovereign power over human limitations and promises to equip and guide His servants, emphasizing that excuses cannot hinder His divine purpose.
